definitions.offensivePossessions: Distinct nflverse play-by-play drive identifiers with a recorded possession team.
definitions.offensivePlays: Median team snap total reconstructed from player offense_snaps / offense_pct, rounded to a whole play.
definitions.ecr: Current FantasyPros redraft-overall expert consensus rank distributed by DynastyProcess through nflverse; null means the player is not currently ranked.
definitions.nullSemantics: null means unknown or unavailable; 0 means a verified zero
